title: A campaign cannot pass image stores to its members
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)

evidence.verified: TestImageStoresReachEveryMember, TestImageStoresRefuseAName and TestImageStoresLeaveTheCampaignIDAlone pass under `go test ./internal/cli/ -count=1`. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: A profile's `imageStores`, in `defaults` or on a member, names shared image stores. Each becomes an `--image-store` on that member's create, and a member's own list replaces the defaults', as `env` does. A profile naming none keeps its campaign ID.
details: `cs-sandbox create --image-store` mounts a shared image store in a member, which is how an image built on the host reaches a member that cannot build one. A profile has no field for it, so a campaign cannot use it.
